outcome: Mode of delivery (successful Trial of Labor After Cesarean delivery - TOLAC, or repeat Cesarean section)
cohort: All patients admitted for a Trial of Labor After Cesarean delivery at term with a live singleton fetus with cephalic presentation between January 2015 and December 2021 at a university tertiary medical center.
finding: Epidural analgesia was not significantly associated with the risk of repeat Cesarean section among women undergoing Trial of Labor After Cesarean delivery, regardless of the indication for the preceding Cesarean section.
mod_finding: The employment of epidural analgesia had no observable influence on the success of TOLAC (mode of delivery), irrespective of the indication for the previous CS.
